attacks.name: Symbiote Tendrils
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§bleed§Bleed| special condition.

attacks.name: We Are Venom
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character removes 1 |!damage| from itself for each 1 |!damage| inflicted.

superPowers.name: Klyntar Rage
superPowers.body: Choose an interactive terrain feature or an enemy character, both of |!size| 3 or less and within |!range| 2, and Throw it |!range_medium|. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Web Snare
superPowers.body: Push an enemy character within |!range| 4 Toward this character |!range_medium|. A character can be Pushed by this superpower only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: So Many Snacks
superPowers.body: After an attack against this character is resolved, it may use this superpower. If the attacker is within |!range| 3, this character may make an attack against the attacker. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Symbiotic Instincts
superPowers.body: When this character is attacking, the defender cannot modify their defense dice.
